objects.name: API Calls
objects.description: API calls utilized by an application that could indicate malicious activity

x_mitre_log_sources.name: Application Vetting
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: None

x_mitre_log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: Repeated sandbox or policy violations by a single process or app bundle (for example, deny rules) followed by successful access to resources or APIs that normally require higher privileges

x_mitre_log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: mmap with PROT_EXEC and PROT_WRITE by sandboxed app

x_mitre_log_sources.name: android:logcat
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: SELinux AVC related to execute_no_trans/execmem after decode/unpack activity by the same app UID

x_mitre_log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: APK or IPA contains SystemProperties.get() calls, Runtime.exec getprop invocations, or code patterns checking for emulator artifacts (ro.product.model=sdk, IMEI=000000, screen size, sensor absence) — static detection of environment-check co

x_mitre_log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
x_mitre_log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: IPA contains UIDevice.currentDevice.model checks for Simulator strings, CMMotionManager.isDeviceMotionAvailable comparisons, or other Simulator-detection patterns — static detection of iOS environment-check code
